notes: ACCESS: root domain and robots.txt were behind a Cloudflare managed challenge (403 'Just a moment...') under plain requests/WebFetch; bypassed via curl_cffi TLS impersonation (chrome131/chrome124/safari17_0/firefox133 profiles rotated with retry - the challenge is probabilistic per-request, not a hard per-profile block, so 4-8 retries against a persistent session reliably got 200s). robots.txt (fetched via impersonation) is a generic 'User-agent: * ' policy disallowing only /login.php, /account, /shopping_cart.php, b2b paths, and ~140 unserved-locale paths (en-XX for countries the site does not actually localise into, e.g. en-in, en-za) - no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web disallow found, so no Rule 3 opt-out applies. LOCALE: site renders natively in English; canonical tag on every page resolves to the /en-us/ locale path regardless of entry URL (confirmed: unprefixed https://www.finnishdesignshop.com/lighting/ceiling-lamps 200s and self-canonicalizes to /en-us/lighting/ceiling-lamps) - no translation needed, matching the brief's Nordic-retailer expectation (consistent with S.N. 149 Nordic Nest and S.N. 150 RoyalDesign). QTY METHOD: the storefront is a Vue SPA over a PHP backend; category pages render only a skeleton loader server-side (no SSR count), the real listing is fetched client-side from a first-party JSON API discovered by reverse-engineering the site's own JS bundle (assets/ApiCatalogProducts-*.js): GET /api/v1/catalog/products?qs=<urlencoded JSON {uri, language, region, perPage, page, fields}> returns data.products.pagination.total. IMPORTANT: 'uri' must be the bare category path WITHOUT the /en-us locale prefix (e.g. '/lighting/ceiling-lamps') - passing the locale-prefixed path silently drops the category filter and returns the whole-catalogue total (22519) instead, a trap verified and avoided throughout. The same API also returns the live category tree (additional.categories.path[-1].children) with real category IDs/paths, which was used to enumerate the full type tree (this surfaced several sub-categories absent from the mega-nav, e.g. Candle snuffers, Tealight holders, Scented candles, Fireplace accessories, Holiday decorations). RULE 1 VERIFICATION: ran a perPage=1 total fetch + perPage=50 last-page exhaustion check (actual item count on the computed last page vs expected remainder, plus implicit page-beyond-last=0 spot check on the first category) for all 55 leaf rows in this file - 55/55 passed with zero mismatches, 0 nulled qtys. EXCLUSIONS: Furniture, Rugs, Bedroom (textiles/furniture), Storage furniture/baskets/containers/coat-racks/magazine-racks (functional storage, except Jars and Boxes - kept, see below), Lifestyle and Housekeeping (electronics/books/games/stationery/DIY/sauna/travel/pets), Kitchenware (utensils/small appliances/cookware/knives/kitchen textiles) and Kitchenware>Coffee and Tea (espresso makers/kettles/French presses/vacuum flasks - functional brewing/travel equipment, appliance-dominant mixed rollup even where teapots appear, dropped per 'drop dont pad'), Tableware>Cutlery, Tableware>Table linen/Napkins (textile), Tableware>Coasters (functional/textile mixed), Tableware>Serving (86 items, sampled titles are entirely serving utensils - tongs/ladles/spatulas/salad-servers/cake-lifters - functionally cutlery, not dinnerware), Bathroom textiles/Hygiene and Cosmetics/Laundry baskets/Sauna accessories/Toiletry bags/Bathroom accessories(toilet brushes and paper holders), Outdoor furniture/textiles/parasols/gardening/barbecue/beach-pool/outdoor showers/outdoor activities, Decor>Cushions/Fabrics/Wallpapers/Curtains/Paints/Fireplace accessories/Holiday decorations, Decor>Wall hanging (3 items, mixed throw+wall-art+room-divider, dropped as mixed/negligible), Decor>Indoor gardening>Plant stands (34 items, sampled titles mostly actual furniture - side tables, trolleys, shelves - not decor) and >Watering cans (functional tool), Decor>Posters and Memory boards>Memory boards (80, functional pinboards/noticeboards) and >Magnets (4, functional), Decor>Decorative objects>Numbers and Letters (0 products, empty), Decor>Candles and Candleholders>Scented candles (explicit exclude), Lighting>Lighting accessories (both the light-bulbs leaf and the same-named 'lighting-accessories' leaf which sampled as pendant cord sets/canopies/cable cups - wiring/assembly hardware, excluded per Rule 0.2), For Kids (furniture/tableware/textiles/books/toys and the non-decor Kids decor siblings: Kids small storage, Kids wallpapers, Kids memo boards) except the Kids Decor decor-typed leaves kept per Rule 0 (see row-level note). RULE 0 GAINS: Bathroom Lighting, Bathroom Mirrors, Bathroom Hooks (all under the 'Bathroom' room node - kept per Rule 0.4/0.1/0.3 despite the room-word name), the full Outdoor Lighting room-branch (6 leaves) plus Lighting>Outdoor Lamps type-branch (both kept, overlap documented per Rule 0.6), Outdoor>Bird Feeders and Birdhouses (decorative ceramic birdhouses/ornamental feeders, not garden tools), and the Kids Decor decor-typed leaves (Kids Mobiles/Figurines/Money boxes/Clocks/Posters - judged in-scope because the product TYPE matches the adult decor include-list, per Rule 0's product-type-over-label principle extended by analogy from room-words to the 'Kids' segment label; this is a judgment call flagged here for the orchestrator, distinct from this project's prior broader 'For Kids' exclusions on other companies which were toy/furniture-dominant). DUPLICATE-COMPANY CHECK: Finnish Design Shop is not on this batch's duplicate-flag list and no prior S.N. in this project extracted finnishdesignshop.com; it is an independent Finnish multi-brand marketplace (own catalogue of ~900+ manufacturers per its brand facet, e.g. Artek, Iittala, HAY, Louis Poulsen, Marimekko - some brand overlap with S.N. 149 Nordic Nest / S.N. 150 RoyalDesign is expected and normal for multi-retailer Nordic design distribution, not evidence of a single-owner duplicate).
